candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Ranking Engineer, Marketplace Search

## Experience

- Released five ranking models to the production search service of the marketplace between 2023 and 2025, each under a traffic ramp from one per cent to full traffic and each on a release ticket in my name.
- Took on-call duty for ranking incidents throughout that period; the feature store outage of autumn 2024 was mine to handle, and the search incident log carries my incident record for it.
- Read the live relevance and conversion dashboards after every release and in the weekly ranking review, and rolled one release back in 2024 when the conversion dashboard showed a regression on low-traffic categories.
- Evaluated every model offline against held-out interaction data under the evaluation protocol agreed with data science before it went to the release review with the search platform team, where the release ticket recorded which checks were mine.
- Wrote the model card for each of the five models: training window, offline and post-release results, the known weakness on low-traffic categories, and what the next engineer needed to know.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the five release tickets with their traffic ramp records, the search incident log record for the feature store outage and the weekly ranking review deck for the last quarter.
